allowedActions: Terminate only the PID recorded in receipts/vite.pid when its command resolves to this arm's Vite working directory.
Terminate only the Firebase CLI root PID recorded in receipts/emulator.pid and its validated descendants.
Verify assigned ports 9299, 8280, 9280, 5287, 4287, 4501, 4502 and Firestore websocket port 9150 are closed.
Leave source, package locks, browser evidence, logs, and receipts intact.
Remove the arm-local browser profile and XDG cache/config only after evidence capture.
forbidden: Deletion of evidence receipts or unrelated baseline state
postCleanupProbe: All arm-bound ports closed; project emulator endpoint unreachable; exact runtime PIDs absent.
